chunks: Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ali, who said:
I saw a seed-shaped cloth upon Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abu Al-Hasan, a title for the Imam
key_terms.عَدَسِيّاً: A type of cloth characterized by small, seed-like patterns or texture

ai.seo_question: What type of clothing did Imam Al-Hasan (AS) wear according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This brief narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the asceticism (*zuhd*) of Imam al-Rida (AS), illustrating that his modesty extended even to the specific texture of his garments rather than just their color. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often cited to demonstrate that the Imams avoided ostentation while maintaining dignity, serving as a practical model for believers to emulate simplicity in daily life. The term 'Adasi' specifically denotes a fabric resembling the color or pattern of lentils, reinforcing the theme of unadorned elegance.
